title: Quarterly alignment lattice: mapping constraints to delivery for Hosted API and Model Catalog
creator: Avery Chen
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable quarterly planning artifact that ties product commitments for Hosted API and the Model Catalog to operational constraints (capacity, latency SLOs, cost envelopes, and evaluation gates). Scope: this ticket synthesizes the input from infra capacity forecasts, runtime performance experiments, product requirements, and customer signals to produce an aligned delivery plan and a 'constraints lattice' that PM/Eng/Design can reference during sprint planning and exec reviews. Outcome: a published quarter plan that 1) defines which model lineups are eligible for shipment in the quarter, 2) attaches capacity and risk budgets to each commitment, 3) prescribes gating criteria (eval pass thresholds, canary percentages, rollback triggers), and 4) produces a deprecation/rotation calendar for low-tier models.
goals: Surface hard operational constraints (GPU pool hedges, latency buckets, regional capacity) against feature-level roadmap items
Produce a prioritized list of hosted-model commitments with paired capacity and cost envelopes
Define deterministic gating criteria for model rollouts (eval metrics, quality deltas, infra smoke tests)
Create a model deprecation calendar to reduce drift and simplify fleet maintenance
milestones: Feb 17 - Constraint discovery workshop with Infra, Runtime, and Capacity Planning
Feb 24 - Draft lattice published and cross-functional review (PM/Eng/Design/SE)
Mar 10 - Finalized commitment list and release windows (canary/gradual rollout dates)
Mar 21 - Operational runbook and gating checklist published in Confluence
Mar 31 - Exec sync and sign-off; push commitments to sprint backlog
deliverables: Constraint lattice doc (mapping of commitments to capacity/cost/latency/QA gates)
Commitment table (model, endpoint, release window, capacity allocation, rollback policy)
Canary schedule and automated gating checklist (CI/QA/Runtime smoke tests)
Deprecation/rotation calendar for Q2 and Q3
One-pager for executive review summarizing risks and mitigation plans
acceptance_criteria: All committed hosted endpoints have an associated capacity allocation and cost envelope recorded
Each model in the commitment list has explicit gating criteria (eval threshold, quality metric delta, canary size)
Operations and Runtime have signed off on the canary schedule and rollback triggers
Design/Developer Experience has reviewed any API surface changes with migration notes
A single Confluence artifact exists that teams can reference for sprint planning and incident triage
risks: Capacity forecast variance during seasonal demand peaks could force last-minute deferrals
Model eval regressions requiring unexpected retraining or rollback
Insufficient automation for gate enforcement could lead to manual bottlenecks
Cross-team alignment slips (engineering or infra delays) could cascade into missed release windows
